reviews.review: Super fun game, a little buggy, but usually pretty good unless it requires a mission restart. Can't wait for more content tho.

[b] Nice Coop 4 player game -> Minecraft meet Vermintide/L4D [/b] (Fear the Boomer bugs)

- I like the graphics + Characters design 
- Music is Top Notch and voice acting rock
- Price is really decent for the content imo 

- Download (less than 4GB) - set up ur control and settings (will take only few min) - play the tutorial > I always appeciate to play a game where you don't have to spend half an hours to set up the game.

- Great with friends : like Vermintide and L4D, playing with random ninja noob can be painfull -> higher lvl player know what to do and the experienced players are usually nice and friendly (add steam friend when you can and read a steam guide will make your experience more fun :)

"Leave no dwarf behind" -> Except may be Mr Ninja lonewolf predator reaper (Bugs need food as well :)

Rock and Stone, Brothers

Tips : 
- using the laser pointer let you see your team mate location
- The enginner can repack is turret when pressing Reload  while holding any weapon (Thx Soly :)

This game is ok, dwarfs are awesome.  The game seems to crash alot for me, almost every other game I try to join I crash.  When I get into a game it runs smoothly.  That being said, when I am in a game, I just dont have that much fun.  You shoot bugs and mine ore.  Thats about it.  If you have a group of friends who all play togather, I could see this being amazing.  If you dont, you will hate it.

is the game fun? yes.
right now though I think it needs alot of balancing.
on the highest difficulties there is too much swarm. there should be a set of enemies , when they are killed there should be some time to gather resources. it just gets way too spammy and too clustered imho.
I also think that shields are way too nerfed. 
Good game but some mechanics are frustrating. I don't like friendly fire in frantic games, also falling damage is kinda annoying. I wish there were upgrades to like not be damaged by poison vapour.
Other points: need more starting ammo
In general I think that hazard 2 is the best mode because rewards are good and it is so much easier to complete a mission. High difficulties just don't seem worth the time.
Last we need a medic class.
Just my two cents. For the price it's not bad and the developers seem like they care about opinions
fun and looks like it has lots of potential
